tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (4.7:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Energy, rebellion, visibility. Used as text on `.logo`, `.stat-label`, `.card-badge`; shadow/glow on `.page-title`, `.card-title`, `.button-primary:hover`. 1.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Nature, alternative values. Used as text on `.button-secondary:hover`; shadow/glow on `.button-secondary:hover`. 8.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Warmth, creativity.

tokens.name: color-dark
tokens.usage: Grounding, contrast. Used as text on `body`, `nav a:hover`, `.page-title`. 15.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-light
